_comment: STEERING FILE (spec §6.1). Vendor identity predicts behavior more reliably than anything on the document. ap-setup copies this to <workDir>/vendors.json and reconciles match_names/aliases with Ian against the real Job Boss + QuickBooks + Suppliers/ vendor lists. handling: file_only | standard | statement_only. This is the file the system LEARNS into over time (new vendors appended after human confirmation; extraction notes appended per vendor). Tolerances are NEVER learned — preset only.

vendors.why: On auto-pay. Ian never enters it; he files it for the record only.
Monthly business insurance premium. Auto-pay, no PO.
Out of state. Invoice always beats the goods. The workflow for these always hits not-yet-received. Do NOT report as an anomaly.
Hydraulic kits get reconfigured during the build, so the invoice drifts from the PO. This supplier almost never matches.

vendors.statement_note: Messy statements — frequent credits and aged rows. Review every aged row.

extraction_notes._comment: Per-vendor learned quirks about how their documents get READ (e.g. 'invoice # and PO # are swapped in the header', 'PO printed as P.O 1234 with a space', 'scanned, needs OCR'). The operational skill may auto-append here (low risk — a bad note only causes a flag Ian already reviews) and logs each addition in the report. These influence EXTRACTION only, never the entry/match path.
